entry.title: v1.22.1
entry.content:
CLI

  • Fix GitHub API rate limit errors in aitools list and plugin installs by pinning skills to 0.2.32. (#7159)

entry.title: v1.22.0
entry.content:
CLI

  • Fix databricks aitools install overwriting newer raw skills with an older pinned release. CLI 1.22.0 and newer now install the latest published skills and prevent automatic downgrades. (#7069)
  • Fix auth login --timeout not applying to the browser login, which waited for the OAuth redirect indefinitely. (#7103)
  • Remove the 50-workspace limit in auth login and support searching workspaces by name or ID. (#7071)
  • databricks ssh connect now fails right away with the workspace's reason when port forwarding to serverless compute is disabled, instead of waiting out the server start timeout. (#7057)

AI Runtime

  • air run now spends less time before submitting: it fetches only the user name from SCIM. (#7153)
  • Align multi-image container name validation with backend services: allow hyphens and up to 32 characters, and reject uppercase letters and underscores. (#7154)

Bundles

  • The compute_id deprecation warning for a target now shows the full path (targets.<name>.compute_id). (#7048)
  • Add DATABRICKS_BUNDLE_STRICT_PROFILE_MATCH, which requires a target's host and workspace ID to match exactly one profile in the config file before authenticating. Targets without a host or workspace ID are not affected. (#7109)
  • Zero-value overrides of presets, lifecycle.prevent_destroy and deployment settings in includes now replace non-zero base values, and bundle validate -o json shows explicit zero presets. (#7117)
  • bundle deployment bind and unbind now accept a resource as type.key, e.g. jobs.foo. (#7128)
  • Retry more transient server errors during bundle deploy and bundle destroy, including when releasing the deploy lock and reading state. (#7129)
  • Fix migration from Terraform failing when a deployed resource references a resource that was never deployed. (#7157)
  • Add app-appkit to bundle templates to simplify starting a Databricks Apps project. (#7004, #7007)
  • Add support for the features resource type. (#6952)
  • Fix bundle validate warning that sync.include and sync.exclude patterns do not match any files when sync.paths includes a directory outside the bundle root. (#7122)

Dependency Updates

  • Bump dependencies with known vulnerabilities. (#7083)
  • Bump Go to 1.27.2. Release binaries now require macOS 13 Ventura or later. (#7052)
  • Update the Go SDK to v0.189.0. (#7138)
  • Bump Go toolchain to 1.27.3. (#7116)

entry.title: v1.21.0
entry.content:
Release v1.21.0 (2026-10-14)

CLI

  • Support pipeline IDs in pipelines history. (#6995)
  • Show a hint for previewing more rows in pipelines show. (#6995)
  • databricks environments setup-local now uses the environment in UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT when it is set, as uv sync does. (#7026)
  • databricks environments setup-local now supports uv workspace members: it uses the shared .venv at the workspace root and writes the dependency constraints to the root pyproject.toml. (#7018)

AI Runtime

  • Limit databricks air run submission preflight validation to one five-second attempt before continuing when the service is unavailable. (#6994)

Bundles

  • Bundle file uploads now use the multipart POST /api/2.0/workspace/import endpoint instead of the deprecated POST /api/2.0/workspace-files/import-file, raising the per-workspace upload rate limit and improving deploy throughput under concurrency. (#6149)
  • Diagnostic paths now quote map keys that are not identifiers, e.g. resources.jobs['${var.env}_job']. (#6980)
  • No longer include CLAUDE.md in the bundle templates, now that Claude supports AGENTS.md. (#7000)
  • Fix bundle deployment bind silently binding over a deployment state it could not read, which could take over a resource that was already managed by the bundle. (#6331)
  • databricks bundle deploy, databricks bundle sync and databricks sync now retry file, library, state and metadata uploads that fail with a transient server error (5xx or 408), instead of failing. (#7014)
  • databricks bundle deploy, databricks bundle sync and databricks sync now retry the workspace path check (workspace/get-status) when it fails with a transient server error (5xx or 408) or an HTTP/2 REFUSED_STREAM, instead of failing. (#7044)
  • Fixed experimental.immutable_folder failing validation for targets with mode: development ("file_path must start with '~/' or contain the current username"). (#7027)
  • Fixed experimental.immutable_folder failing with experimental.deployment_history ("workspace_info.file_path must be an absolute workspace path") and failing bundle validate when top-level permissions are set. (#7001)
  • Translate relative .env file paths in a job's environment_variables[].spec.files to their deployed workspace locations. (#6985)
  • Resolve job project_environment paths relative to the YAML file that defines them. (#6983)

Dependency Updates

  • Bump Go toolchain to 1.26.9. (#6996)
  • Update Go SDK to 0.188.0. (#7038)

entry.title: v1.20.0
entry.content:
Release v1.20.0

Notable Changes

  • Remove the Terraform deployment engine. bundle.engine: terraform and DATABRICKS_BUNDLE_ENGINE=terraform now error, and a failed migration of existing Terraform state is reported as an error instead of falling back to Terraform. To keep deploying with Terraform, use Databricks CLI v1.19.x. (#6888, #6889)

CLI

  • databricks aitools install now supports Kiro, installing Databricks agent skills into its skills directory. (#6908)
  • Fixed databricks api corrupting integers larger than 2^53 (such as job and pipeline ids) — request bodies and responses now preserve them exactly. (#6884)
  • Added --auth-mode and --set <plugin>.<resourceKey>.authMode=obo|sp|both to databricks apps init so AppKit resources can be accessed on behalf of the user, by the service principal, or both. The default stays service principal. (#6886)
  • databricks apps init now requires a value for every field a service principal resource binding references, prompting for missing values in an interactive terminal and otherwise failing with the --set key to use, instead of creating a project with unset variables. (#6903)
  • Add databricks apps init --package-manager <npm|pnpm> to select the package manager for Node.js templates. Infer the default quietly from template lockfiles and AppKit version, check prerequisites before creating files, and preserve template formatting and pnpm version pins. (#6902)
  • Select npm or pnpm from packageManager declarations and lockfiles for apps validate and project validation during apps deploy. (#6892)
  • Fix auth docker host reporting the credential helper as configured when its executable is missing from PATH. (#6880)
  • Warn when the CLI binary was built more than 6 months ago and recommend updating. (#6898)

AI Runtime

  • Add an experimental rank-partitioned container images to AI Runtime jobs. (#6841)
  • Support snapshot fields directly under code_source without requiring type or a nested snapshot block. (#6927)
  • Map AIR priority and Unity Catalog image fields when converting run configurations to bundles. (#6905)
  • Add workspace backend validation to air run --dry-run. (#6934)

Bundles

  • Warn that bundle.terraform is deprecated and has no effect since the Terraform deployment engine was removed. (#6940)
  • Direct engine now detects and applies an explicitly configured zero-value boolean or float (e.g. gcp_attributes.use_preemptible_executors: false, azure_attributes.spot_bid_max_price: 0) added to a resource first deployed without the field, matching the existing handling of an explicit integer zero. (#6882)
  • Fix bundle deployment migrate failing with "no such file or directory" when the Terraform state has no resources or the configuration no longer declares any of them. (#6958)
  • bundle run and pipelines run now send the per-update development parameter for pipelines in development mode targets. Setting development on a pipeline is deprecated and now emits a warning; use mode: development instead. (#6863)
  • Remove the hidden bundle debug terraform command. (#6933)
  • Add support for run_as.group_name at the bundle and target levels for jobs and pipelines. (#6676)
  • Fix recreating a secret scope that was deleted outside of the bundle with the direct deployment engine. (#6970)
  • Accept title-case booleans (True/False, as rendered by Azure Pipelines) for boolean variables, and accept the same boolean strings (yes/no, on/off, ...) in Python bundles as in YAML. (#6942)

Dependency Updates

  • Bump github.com/databricks/databricks-sdk-go from v0.182.0 to v0.185.0. (#6928)
